title: G&M Escavatori
description: Corporate website for a civil earthmoving company. Built from scratch: service sections, photo gallery, and contact form — designed to work on any device and load fast for clients in the field.
longDescription: Full custom website for a local civil earthmoving company. The goal was a clean, professional online presence that clearly communicates services and makes it easy for potential clients to get in touch. Built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with a PHP-powered contact form.
